chapter-b2-50-nominalisierung-data.js.title: Nominalisierung
chapter-b2-50-nominalisierung-data.js.intro: In a seminar, Katja and Timo turn everyday complaints — rising rents, a problem that took weeks to pin down — into the formal nouns German prefers: die Erhöhung der Mietkosten, die Untersuchung der Ursache.

chapter-b2-51-erweiterte-partizipialattr.title: Erweiterte Partizipialattribute
chapter-b2-51-erweiterte-partizipialattr.intro: In a sleep laboratory, Marret and Timo describe a participant sleepless for three nights and data collected carefully by the team — every relative clause compressed into a compact participial phrase set right before the noun.

chapter-b2-52-komplexe-nominalgruppen-da.title: Komplexe Nominalgruppen
chapter-b2-52-komplexe-nominalgruppen-da.intro: A Nobel-laureate\'s visit next week has Runa and Timo excited — the theory developed by him, esteemed by so many researchers, changes how they see the world — every description layering adjectives, participles and genitives around one head noun.

chapter-b2-53-goethe-mini-4-data.js.title: Goethe Mini 4
chapter-b2-53-goethe-mini-4-data.js.intro: The night before the B2 checkpoint, Nadine has her documents prepared and Timo still has questions explained by his teacher — moving fluidly from Zustandspassiv all the way to complex noun groups, one last time.

chapter-b2-54-funktionsverbgefuege-data..title: Funktionsverbgefüge
chapter-b2-54-funktionsverbgefuege-data..intro: Before a meeting, Karla takes consideration of Timo\'s arguments and he puts his trust in the discussion ahead — every plain verb swapped for the formal noun + light-verb construction German prefers: eine Entscheidung treffen, Rücksicht nehmen.

chapter-b2-55-modalpartikeln-doch-ja-dat.title: Modalpartikeln: doch / ja
chapter-b2-55-modalpartikeln-doch-ja-dat.intro: Ines can\'t find her keys, and Timo is sure they\'re on the table — they\'re indeed not there — until he suggests the jacket and, well, there they indeed are. doch and ja carry all the extra feeling the plain facts can\'t.

chapter-b2-56-modalpartikeln-eben-halt-d.title: Modalpartikeln: eben / halt
chapter-b2-56-modalpartikeln-eben-halt-d.intro: Nike is disappointed after a national-team loss and a nervous personal setback, and Timo shrugs it off with her — that\'s just how it goes, halt, eben — the two little words native speakers use to simply accept reality.

chapter-b2-57-textkohaerenz-verweiswoert.title: Textkohärenz: Verweiswörter
chapter-b2-57-textkohaerenz-verweiswoert.intro: Meret shows Timo a summary she\'s written — one paragraph about the topic, in it an explanation; the next about the solution, this one — replacing repeated nouns with clear, natural reference words.

chapter-b2-58-textkohaerenz-absatzlogik-.title: Textkohärenz: Absatzlogik
chapter-b2-58-textkohaerenz-absatzlogik-.intro: Anke needs feedback on her cover letter, and Timo walks her through the logic — introduce yourself, justify your motivation, then summarize — one paragraph, one idea, in a clear order.

chapter-b2-59-konjunktiv-i-formen-data.j.title: Konjunktiv I: Formen
chapter-b2-59-konjunktiv-i-formen-data.j.intro: Reading a newspaper quote from a coach about an exciting kart race, Ida and Timo notice the verb forms look slightly off — ist becomes sei — the foundation for reported speech next chapter.

chapter-b2-60-indirekte-rede-grundlagen-.title: Indirekte Rede: Grundlagen
chapter-b2-60-indirekte-rede-grundlagen-.intro: Over the morning paper, Petra reports what her brother said about a tennis pro\'s win, and Timo notices neither of them is claiming it\'s true — every reported statement carried neutrally by Konjunktiv I.
